changelog.title: Layout Realignment & 'Radio A' Studio Hub, Clocks, Weather & Now Playing Trivia
changes: **Radio Layout Hierarchy (Radio A, Radio B, Radio C, DJ)**
Layout Mode Hierarchy: Renamed and organized the top banner layout mode switcher to `[ 🎙️ Radio A ] -> [ 📻 Radio B ] -> [ 📻 Radio C ] -> [ 🎧 DJ ]`.

Radio A (Flagship Studio Hub): The complete live broadcast console featuring vertically stacked Studio Hub clocks & live weather, Now Playing metadata & TheAudioDB/MusicBrainz trivia engine, 5-channel Web Radio Mixer, and the 4-slot square CART Wall.
Radio B (Pure Mixer & Cart Wall): The streamlined pure mixer console with 160px vertical faders, precision '-MM:SS.d' countdown badges, 10s flashing ending alert, and the 4-slot CART Wall.
Radio C (Dual-Deck Studio Workstation): Clean broadcast layout featuring dual playback decks with scrolling and overview waveforms, transport strips, pitch sliders, and central broadcast mixer.

Dual Studio Digital Clocks: Features real-time precision digital clocks for Local Host Time (with automatic timezone city detection) and Perth Western Australia Time (AWST / UTC+8) for the main station broadcast headquarters.
Live Broadcast Weather Monitors: Fetches real-time temperature and weather conditions via Open-Meteo API for both the Perth WA broadcast station and the host's local broadcast location.
Now Playing Metadata & Artwork: Displays high-visibility album artwork, title, artist, release year, record label, BPM, and musical key for the active track.

Presenter Liner & Music Trivia Engine: Generates intelligent on-air talkover liners, harmonic mixing notes (Camelot wheel compatible), record release trivia, and artist biographies, complete with a '↺ Next Fact' presenter cycle button.

Live TheAudioDB & MusicBrainz Integration: Asynchronously enriches on-air trivia with real-world artist biographies, birth/formation history, country of origin, official record labels, and release discography notes via live public API queries with smart memory caching.

changelog.title: Broadcast CART Wall, CART Library & Dedicated Mixer Channel Strip (Radio Presenter B)
changes: **Broadcast CART Wall Subsystem & Studio Pad Controller**
Dedicated CART Wall Pad Grid: Introduced a 4-slot square-shaped CART pad wall positioned directly to the right of the Web Radio Mixer in the 'Radio Presenter B' studio layout.

Single 'CARTS' Mixer Channel Strip: Created a dedicated gold/amber channel strip placed to the right of CH B (`[ MST ] -> [ MIC ] -> [ CH A ] -> [ CH B ] -> [ CARTS ]`) with full 160px vertical volume fader, real-time VU meter, active slot status counter, and instant master kill switch (⏹ STOP ALL).
Dedicated CART Library Tab: Added a 3rd top-level library tab alongside '📁 Track Library' and '📋 Cued Playlists' for managing sound effects, jingles, station sweepers, and station ID drops.
Quick Pad Assignment & Auditioning: Load any cart to pads via quick action buttons (`+C1`, `+C2`, `+C3`, `+C4`), audition previews (▶), and manage entries with search filtering.

Track Library Import Relocation & Renaming: Moved and unified import actions in the '📁 Track Library' tab toolbar as '➕ Import Files' and '📁 Import Folder', establishing clean visual and functional symmetry with the 'CART Library'.

Multi-Format Import, Folder Scanning & Drag-and-Drop: Import individual audio files or entire directories (`📁 Import Folder`) directly into the CART library, drag-and-drop files onto Cart Wall pads, or synthesize 4 instant broadcast demo jingles (`⚡ Demo Jingles`).

Top Banner Layout Switcher Reorganization: Reordered and renamed the layout switcher buttons to [ 📻 Radio A ] (Pure Mixer + CART Wall), [ 🎙️ Radio B ] (Dual Deck Studio Layout), and [ 🎧 DJ ] (Full DJ Controller Console).
Real-Time Countdown & Progress Glow: Pads feature animated progress bars, live time remaining readouts, active status LEDs, and retriggering capabilities.

changelog.title: Playback 'Time Left' Live Countdown on Mixer Channel Strips (Radio Presenter B)
changes: **Precision Playback Countdown Monitors (Radio Presenter B)**

Live 'Time Left' Digital Badges: Integrated dedicated high-visibility time remaining countdown gauges (`-MM:SS.d`) directly on Channel A (CH A) and Channel B (CH B) mixer strips below the track metadata.
Presenter Precision Down to Fractions: Powered by 60fps Web Audio playback timers, giving broadcasters exact sample-accurate countdown visibility without needing deck faceplates on screen.
Color-Coded & Alert Synchronized: Formatted in JetBrains Mono with channel neon accents (Cyan for CH A, Magenta for CH B) and flashes high-visibility alert red when entering the 10-second end window.
Unified Strip Symmetry: Master strip displays active audio bus mode (`BUS: STEREO`), and the live microphone strip displays real-time on-air status (`STATUS: ON AIR / MUTED`).

changelog.title: Microphone (MIC) Channel Strip Relocation to the Left of CH A
changes: **Broadcast Console Channel Strip Reordering**
Standard Broadcast Strip Sequence: Relocated the Live Microphone strip (MIC) to the left side of Channel A across all layouts (DJ Console, Radio Presenter, and Radio Presenter B).

New Symmetrical Mixer Layout: Channel sequence is now organized as [ MST ] -> [ MIC ] -> [ CH A ] -> [ CH B ], grouping master and presenter input controls together on the left followed by the dual deck playback channels on the right.
Full Feature Continuity: Preserves 160px luxury fader throw, real-time LED peak VU meter, ON AIR / TALK ducking triggers, track info displays, and 10-second track end flashing alerts.

changelog.title: 10-Second End-of-Track Flashing Red Alert on Mixer Channel Strips (CH A & CH B)
changes: **Channel Strip Red Flashing Broadcast Alert**

Broadcast-Grade Ending Warning: When a track has 10 seconds or less remaining on CH A or CH B, the corresponding mixer channel strip card pulses with an unmistakable flashing neon red alert (#ff1744).

Universal Layout Support: Flashes vividly across both '🎙️ Radio Presenter' and '📻 Radio Presenter B' (as well as DJ Console) layouts, alerting hosts and presenters even when deck faceplates are hidden.

Full Component Alert Highlighting: Synchronizes glowing red alert pulses across the channel card border, card background glow, album artwork badge, 'CH A'/'CH B' strip title label, track info badges, and square Play/Pause buttons.
Real-Time Glitch-Free Monitoring: Powered by the 60fps Web Audio playback time monitor, instantly engaging and resetting seamlessly on deck transitions.

changelog.title: Loaded & Playing Track Displays in Web Radio Mixer (Radio Presenter B Mode)
changes: **Channel Strip Track Information Monitors (Radio Presenter B)**
Dedicated Track Info Badges: Integrated compact real-time track metadata badges directly inside Channel A (CH A) and Channel B (CH B) mixer strips beneath the album artwork.

Exclusive to Radio Presenter B: Seamlessly displays the loaded/playing track title and artist name exclusively when in '📻 Radio Presenter B' mode, remaining hidden in DJ Console and standard Radio Presenter modes.

Live Playback Glow & Alert Warning: Active tracks illuminate with dynamic color-matched neon glow (Cyan for CH A, Magenta for CH B) and flash high-visibility alert red when less than 10 seconds remain on the playing track.
Metadata Synchronization: Automatically reflects instant updates from ID3 tag parsing, track loading, playlist queue progression, and track info editor changes.
Symmetrical Channel Layout: Preserves uniform height alignment across Master Output (MST), Channel A (CH A), Microphone (MIC), and Channel B (CH B) strips.

changelog.title: Radio Presenter B (Dedicated Web Radio Mixer Layout)
changes: **Pure Web Radio Mixer Layout Mode (Radio Presenter B)**

Dedicated Pure Mixer View: Added a 3rd layout mode '📻 Radio Presenter B' to the top header switcher that exclusively presents the central Web Radio Mixer while cleanly hiding Deck A and Deck B panels.

Full Studio Mixer Controls: Offers a focused, centered 4-channel broadcast interface (MST -> CH A -> MIC -> CH B) with luxury vertical volume faders, real-time stereo peak VU meters, album art badges, and the Auto-Deck Relay controller.

Direct Transport Control: Full track playback control directly from the mixer's square Play/Pause buttons (CH A / CH B) and live microphone ON AIR button without requiring bulky deck faceplates on screen.
Automatic Crossfader Protection: Automatically centers the crossfader (0.5) so both audio channels operate at full unattenuated volume.
Session Persistence: Saves layout preference in localStorage, restoring automatically on launch.

changelog.title: USB MIDI Controller Mapping JSON Export & Import
changes: **Portable MIDI Mappings JSON Storage**

One-Click JSON File Export: Added '💾 Export JSON' button to the MIDI Controller Setup modal to save all custom device mappings, learn bindings, and presets into structured .json files directly to your computer.
Cross-Device & Instance Import: Added '📂 Import JSON' button to load and restore any saved MIDI mapping JSON file on different browser instances, workstations, or computers.
File Validation & Immediate Activation: Validates CC/Note channel configurations and instantly loads mappings into the active Web MIDI engine and local storage.

changelog.title: Recessed Slider Slot Channels for Mixer Faders (CH A, MIC, Master, CH B)
changes: **Tactile Slider Slot Channel Styling**
Recessed Hardware Slot Tracks: Restored visible dark recessed slot channels (similar to the crossfader) across all mixer volume faders (CH A, MIC, Master, CH B).
Ergonomic Groove Alignment: The enlarged circular slider knobs glide seamlessly centered along the dark recessed slot tracks with bevelled borders and inset depth shadows.

changelog.title: Universal Design Ergonomics (Larger Movable Slider Thumbs, High-Contrast Dials & Knobs)
changes: **Universal Design & Accessibility Enhancements**

Enlarged Tactile Slider Thumbs: Standardized larger circular movable thumbs (26px to 30px) across all vertical channel faders (CH A, MIC, Master, CH B) with high-contrast metallic radial shading and channel-specific glowing neon accent rings.
Precision Pitch Slider Thumbs: Added large 22px circular slider thumbs with glowing LED indicator rings and 1.18x hover magnification for effortless tempo adjustment.
Tactile Crossfader Knob: Enhanced the horizontal crossfader with an enlarged 36px x 26px pill fader knob featuring bright contrast borders and hover illumination.

High-Visibility Rotary Dials: Expanded 3-band EQ, Dual-Filter, Master, and On-Deck FX knobs (46px diameter) with thicker (3.5px) illuminated pointers and calibrated pivot origins for crystal-clear viewing from any angle or distance.

changelog.title: Microphone Channel Routing & Mono Centering (Behringer UMC202HD & 2-Ch Interfaces)
changes: **Microphone Channel Routing & Mono Centering Matrix**

Multi-Channel Interface Support: Solved the single-ear panning issue on 2-channel USB audio interfaces (Behringer U-Phoria UMC202HD, Focusrite Scarlett 2i2, etc.) where Input 1 routes exclusively to Left and Input 2 routes to Right.
Precision Channel Routing Selector: Added '🎚️ Mic Channel / Mono Mode' dropdown to B.U.T.T. / Audio Routing with 4 routing modes:
• Mono — Input 1 / Left (Centered): Routes Channel 1 to both Left & Right headphone/broadcast channels equally.
• Mono — Sum L+R (Centered Mix): Blends both inputs to center with -3dB headroom summing.
• Mono — Input 2 / Right (Centered): Centers Channel 2 for mics plugged into input 2.
• Stereo — Separate Left & Right: True unmixed stereo passthrough.
Real-Time Glitch-Free Switching: Web Audio ChannelSplitter / ChannelMerger gain matrix updates on the fly without audio drops or reconnects.
Persistent Preference: Automatically saves the chosen channel routing mode to localStorage.

changelog.title: Pitch Slider Relocation to the Right of SYNC (Deck A & Deck B)
changes: **Standardized Pitch Slider Positioning**
Right-of-SYNC Deck Placement: Repositioned the pitch tempo sliders to the right side of the SYNC button on both Deck A and Deck B.
Transport Sequence: Standardized deck bottom bar layout: [ CUE ] -> [ PLAY / PAUSE ] -> [ SYNC ] -> [ PITCH SLIDER ].
Dual-Layout Consistency: Aligned across both Radio Presenter and DJ Console layouts with live tempo readout and double-click reset.

changelog.title: Pitch Slider Integration to the Left of SYNC (Radio Presenter & DJ Modes)
changes: **Integrated Pitch Slider Transport Control**
Radio Presenter Pitch Control: Restored the precision tempo pitch slider to the Radio Presenter layout, positioned directly to the left of the SYNC button on both Deck A and Deck B.
Unified Transport Bar: Transport strip sequence standardized across all modes: [ CUE ] -> [ PLAY / PAUSE ] -> [ PITCH SLIDER ] -> [ SYNC ].
Compact Visual Gauge: Sleek dark fader box with real-time percentage readout (e.g. +0.0%), smooth slider thumb, and double-click to instant 0.0% reset.

changelog.title: Streamlined DJ Console Layout (Scratch Jog Discs Removed)
changes: **Clean DJ Workstation Interface**
Streamlined Digital Deck Faceplate: Removed the physical turntable/jog scratch discs from the visual layout across the console.

Full-Width Performance Controls: Expanded Hot Cues (1-4), Beat Loops, Beat Roll slip pads, On-Deck Quick FX strips, and pitch transport bars across the entire width of each deck for maximum usability.

changelog.title: Master (MST) Output Strip Relocation to Far-Left Position
changes: **Broadcast Console Channel Strip Reordering**
Master Monitor on Far Left: Relocated the Master Output strip (MST) to the far-left position before Channel A (MST -> CH A -> MIC -> CH B).
Broadcast Console Standard Flow: Aligns with radio studio engineering standards placing master output metering as the left-most reference monitor strip followed by active source channels.

changelog.title: Uniform Height Alignment for Channel Faders, VU Meters & Mixer Strips (CH A, MIC, MST, CH B)
changes: **Channel Fader & VU Meter Geometric Alignment**

Standardized Height Calibration: Calibrated all vertical volume faders and LED peak VU meters across Channel A, Microphone, Master Output, and Channel B to identical heights (110px in DJ Console mode, 160px in Radio Presenter mode).

Equalized Card Baselines: Configured flex-stretch layout with balanced top-to-bottom distribution so that artwork squares, channel labels, faders/meters, and bottom action buttons align horizontally across all channels.
Master Channel Alignment: Added matching bottom status badge to the Master Output strip to ensure consistent card heights and layout symmetry.

changelog.title: Focused Broadcast Mixer Console & Studio Channel Strips (Artwork, Left VU Meter, Square Play/Pause Buttons)
changes: **Studio Broadcast Mixer Redesign**
Dedicated Channel Strips: Restructured Web Radio Mixer with standardized studio broadcast channel strips for Deck A (CH A), Microphone (MIC), and Deck B (CH B) plus Master Output (MST).

Top Album Artwork Badges: Added small square artwork displays at the top of Channel A and Channel B that dynamically sync with loaded track cover art (or fallback placeholder), and a glowing mic avatar for the microphone channel.
Left-Aligned Precision VU Meters: Repositioned real-time LED audio peak VU meters directly to the left of each channel's vertical slider volume control for instant visual level monitoring.

Bottom Square Play/Pause & On-Air Buttons: Added high-visibility square action buttons at the bottom of each channel (Deck A Play/Pause, Mic On-Air toggle, Deck B Play/Pause) with dynamic glowing neon playback status indicators.
Radio Presenter Focus: In Radio Presenter mode, the mixer console expands into the central spotlight with 300px height, 155px luxury fader throw, and bold tactile controls for broadcast hosts.

changelog.title: Dual Layout System: DJ Console vs. Radio Presenter Minimal Broadcast Mode
changes: **Dual Layout System & Minimal Radio Studio Mode**
Header Layout Mode Selector: Added instant layout switching buttons in the top navigation bar to toggle seamlessly between '🎧 DJ Console' and '🎙️ Radio Presenter' modes.

Minimal Radio Presenter Mode: Streamlined broadcast studio interface with clutter-free dual decks featuring large album artwork, track title/artist, dynamic waveforms, and oversized 52px transport buttons (CUE, PLAY/PAUSE, SYNC).

Zero Clutter for Broadcasters: Cleanly hides turntable scratch jog wheels, hot cue pads (1-4), beat loop bars, beat roll pads, on-deck quick FX knobs, 3-band EQ rack, pitch sliders, and equal-power crossfader in Radio mode.
Full Radio Studio Continuity: Retains channel volume faders, live microphone voiceover strip with VU meters & ON AIR indicator, Auto-Deck Relay controller, and dual cued playlist queues.
Automatic Crossfader Protection: Automatically centers the crossfader (0.5) when entering Radio Presenter mode to ensure both deck volume faders operate at 100% full gain.
Persistent State: Remembers layout mode choice in localStorage across page reloads and browser sessions.

changelog.title: Ultra-Low Latency Microphone Audio Pipeline & Zero-Delay Monitoring
changes: **Ultra-Low Latency Mic Optimization**

Bypassed Chromium Internal WebRTC Buffers: Injected proprietary low-latency constraints (`googEchoCancellation: false`, `googAutoGainControl: false`, `googNoiseSuppression: false`, `latency: 0`) to stream directly from CoreAudio / WASAPI ring buffers.
Zero-Delay Parallel Node Tapping: Replaced in-series AnalyserNode routing with zero-delay parallel taps for microphone and deck audio graphs.
Matched Hardware Sample Rate: Bound audio stream ideal sample rate directly to AudioContext.sampleRate (48kHz/44.1kHz), eliminating OS resampling buffer latency.

Local Headphone Monitor / Stream-Only Toggle: Added '🎧 Local Headphone Monitor' toggle in B.U.T.T. / Audio Routing modal so DJs can mute their voice in local headphones while broadcasting 100% to the stream, enabling 0ms hardware direct monitoring.

changelog.title: Studio Raw Microphone Audio (Zero-Gating & Uncompressed Input)
changes: **Studio Raw Voice Processing Fix**

Zero-Gating Studio Input: Disabled aggressive browser WebRTC voice activity detection (VAD), echo cancellation clamping, and AGC noise-gating that were cutting off vocal phrases and muting the microphone.
Full-Bandwidth 48kHz Audio: Configured unconstrained 48kHz stereo/mono microphone ingestion with ultra-low latency scheduling for crystal-clear presenter voiceover.
Interactive DSP Toggles: Added 'Studio Raw Audio (Zero Gate / No Cutoff)' toggle in the B.U.T.T. / Audio Routing modal with optional feedback protection checkboxes.
Robust MediaStream Fallback: Added automatic multi-stage constraint fallback to ensure seamless mic connection across all USB interfaces and Bluetooth headsets.

changelog.title: Live Microphone / Audio Input Routing & Mixer Channel
changes: **Live Microphone & External Audio Input Integration**
Audio Input Device Selector: Added real-time device enumeration to the 'B.U.T.T. / Audio Routing' panel supporting internal mics, bluetooth headsets, audio interfaces, and line-in devices.
Web Radio Mixer Mic Channel: Added a dedicated MIC channel strip in the central mixer featuring a precision gain fader (0%–150%), real-time LED peak VU meter, and glowing ON AIR button.
Talkover Auto-Ducking: Built-in 'TALK' toggle automatically ducks deck music by -9dB when the presenter speaks.
Master & Broadcast Graph Mixing: Mic audio is mixed directly into the master Web Audio graph, feeding local speakers, soundcard outputs, and live radio streams (WebRTC, Icecast, Shoutcast, B.U.T.T.).
Hotkeys & Device Change: Added 'M' keyboard shortcut for instant mic toggling and automated device re-enumeration on USB plug/unplug events.

changelog.title: Metadata Persistence & Engine Stability Patch
changes: **Metadata Stability & Null-Safety Patch**
Null-Safe Track Matching: Fixed TypeError in isSameTrack and library search filtering by guarding all title, artist, and key property accesses against undefined values.
Engine Deck Synchronization: Added direct loadedTrackId matching and safe property propagation across loaded decks and cued playlist queues upon saving metadata edits.
Modern Slider Standards: Eliminated browser deprecation warnings by replacing non-standard slider-vertical styling with standard vertical-lr writing mode.
Console Health: Fixed crossfader element reference in the broadcasting metadata tap and added an inline SVG favicon to prevent 404 network warnings.

changelog.title: Interactive Track Metadata & Cover Art Editor
changes: **Track Metadata Editing & Management**
Metadata Editor Modal: Open via ✏️ button on any track row, toolbar '✏️ Edit Info' button, or double-clicking any track row in the library table.
Editable Track Properties: Adjust Track Title, Artist Name, Album/Release, BPM (Tempo), and Musical Key (Camelot notation dropdown).
Artwork Replacement & Removal: Directly upload or replace cover images (JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF) or remove existing artwork with live visual preview.
One-Click DSP Tempo & Key Re-Analysis: Built-in '⚡ DSP' trigger inside the editor to re-calculate tempo and harmonic key on demand.
Live Deck & Playlist Synchronization: Saving updates instantly propagates metadata and artwork to active Deck A/B headers, overview strips, and cued playlist queues.

changelog.title: Embedded Album Artwork Extraction & Deck Display
changes: **Album Cover Art Integration**
Binary Artwork Extraction: Built parser for ID3v2 APIC (v2.3/v2.4), ID3v2 PIC (v2.2), MP4/M4A covr atom, and FLAC Picture block to extract embedded cover images (JPEG/PNG/WebP).
Deck Faceplate Album Badges: Added glowing artwork display badges to Deck A and Deck B headers that dynamically display the loaded track's album cover art.
Track Library Artwork Thumbnails: Added dedicated ART column in the track library table with rounded cover art thumbnails and musical placeholder badges.
Cued Playlist Artwork Integration: Miniature cover art thumbnails displayed next to each queued track in Deck A and Deck B playlists.

changelog.title: Native ID3 Metadata Parser & DSP BPM / Key Analyzer
changes: **ID3 Tag Extraction & Harmonic Analysis**
Binary Metadata Tag Parser: Built client-side binary parser for ID3v2.2, ID3v2.3, ID3v2.4, ID3v1, MP4/M4A atoms, FLAC Vorbis comments, and WAV RIFF INFO chunks.
Automatic Metadata Ingestion: Directly reads real Artist (TPE1), Title (TIT2), Album (TALB), BPM (TBPM / tmpo), and Musical Key (TKEY / initialkey) from MP3 headers upon import.
DSP Onset Beat Detector: Fast autocorrelation algorithm with 150Hz low-pass bass filtering to accurately detect real-world BPM when ID3 tags are missing.
DSP Chromagram Key Estimator: 12-semitone Pitch Class Profile (PCP) harmonic analysis correlated against Krumhansl-Kessler Major/Minor musical profiles.
Camelot Wheel Notation: Normalizes all musical keys into standard DJ harmonic mixing format (e.g. 8A (Am), 8B (C), 11B (A)).
Deck Faceplate Key Readout: Added dedicated KEY readout boxes to Deck A and Deck B headers beside BPM and TIME.

changelog.title: End-of-Track Visual Warning (10s Alert)
changes: **Studio DJ Broadcast Alerts**
10-Second End-of-Track Red Alert: When a playing track has 10 seconds or less remaining, the deck triggers an unmistakable broadcasting visual alert.
Flashing Track Meta: The track title pulses in glowing neon alert red (#ff1744) to warn the presenter/DJ that the song is finishing.
Flashing Time Readout: The deck's TIME readout badge illuminates and flashes red with high-contrast text.
Waveform Progress Glow: The overview waveform progress bar turns red with an intense neon drop shadow.
Deck Perimeter Glow: The active deck panel pulses with an ambient red border glow until the song ends or a new track transitions in.

changelog.title: On-Deck FX Right-Click Parameter Switcher
changes: **Contextual FX Parameter Assignment**
Right-Click Context Menu: Right-clicking any on-deck FX dial or left-clicking its sublabel opens a popup menu allowing instant assignment of alternate effect parameters.
Echo & Delay Parameters: Select between Feedback (FDBK), Dry/Wet Mix (W/D), Delay Timing (TIME), and Tape Low-Pass Damping (DAMP).
Studio Reverb Parameters: Select between Dry/Wet Mix (W/D) and Decay Time (DECAY).
Flanger & Phaser Parameters: Select between Feedback Resonance (FDBK), Dry/Wet Mix (W/D), LFO Speed (RATE), and Modulation Depth (DEPTH).
Lo-Fi Bitcrusher Parameters: Select between Dry/Wet Mix (W/D) and Bit Depth Crush (BITS).

Auto-Recalibration & Persistence: The rotary knob angle dynamically rescales to the chosen parameter's minimum/maximum range, updates the sublabel badge, and saves preferences across sessions in localStorage.

changelog.title: On-Deck Quick FX Strips & Simplified Rotary Dials
changes: **On-Deck Hardware Quick FX**
Deck-Integrated FX Strips: Added dedicated hardware-style mini FX strips to Deck A and Deck B for instant performance manipulation without opening modals.

Simplified Rotary Controls: Echo & Delay Feedback (FDBK), Studio Reverb Wet/Dry (W/D), Flanger & Phaser Feedback (FDBK), and Lo-Fi Bitcrusher Wet/Dry (W/D) rotary dials with drag gestures and double-click reset.
Individual ON/OFF Buttons: High-contrast toggle buttons with glowing LED status indicators for each of the 4 effects on both decks.
Bi-Directional Synchronization: Real-time state synchronization between on-deck quick dials/LEDs, main Software FX rack modal, and USB MIDI controllers.

changelog.title: Modal Control Stabilization & UI Optimization
changes: **Modal & UI Enhancements**
Broadcast & Software FX Modals: Resolved element listener execution order and guarded button bindings ensuring instant modal opening from both header buttons and mixer triggers.
Header Actions Streamlining: Removed deprecated 'Generate Demo Beat' button from the top navigation bar.
Modal Keyboard Shortcuts: Added direct hotkeys: 'B' to toggle Broadcast / Streaming panel, 'X' to toggle Software FX Rack, 'M' for MIDI controller settings, and 'Esc' to close any modal.

MIDI Momentary Beat Roll Release: Enabled Note-Off and CC zero-velocity release handlers so holding a hardware performance pad loops the selected beat division, and releasing the pad immediately disengages the loop to continue normal forward playback smoothly.

changelog.title: Studio Software FX Rack & Real-Time Performance Effects
changes: **Studio Software FX Engine**
Dual Filter (HPF / LPF): Bi-directional mixer filter knobs with resonance and sweep controls (-100% LPF ... 0 Neutral ... +100% HPF).
Echo & BPM-Synced Delay: Tempo-locked delay timing (1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1, 2 beats), analog tape high-cut damping, feedback, and dry/wet mixing.
Studio Reverb: Real-time algorithmic impulse convolver with Room, Studio, Club, Hall, and Arena spaces, decay time scaling, and mix control.
Flanger / Phaser: Sweeping LFO modulation (0.1 - 5.0 Hz), variable feedback, depth, and stereo motion.
Lo-Fi Bitcrusher: 2-bit to 16-bit step quantization crunch and dynamic drive for chiptune and vintage sampler texture.
Performance Beat Roll (Slip Mode): Momentary slip-loop performance pads (1/16 to 4 beats) that roll seamlessly and resume at the exact real-time playback position upon release.
MIDI Controller Integration: Full MIDI mappings and Learn support for dual filters, FX dry/wet, and beat roll performance pads.

changelog.title: Myriad Cloud Streaming Support & B.U.T.T. Audio Output Routing
changes: **Myriad Cloud (Broadcast Radio) & B.U.T.T. Integration**
B.U.T.T. Direct Audio Routing: Added Master Audio Output Soundcard selector allowing routing to BlackHole 2ch, Loopback, or Virtual Cable for 100% stable, zero-CORS streaming to Myriad Cloud.
Icecast Relay Bridge: Added local 'icecast-bridge.js' companion relay for direct browser WebSocket-to-Icecast TCP streaming.
Broadcast Modal B.U.T.T. Tab: Dedicated step-by-step setup walkthrough with real-time audio device enumeration and switching.

changelog.title: B.U.T.T.-Aligned Icecast Configuration & Stream Diagnostics
changes: **Icecast 2 & BUTT Alignment**
B.U.T.T. Settings Parity: Replaced monolithic URL field with standard BUTT fields: Address/Host, Port, Icecast User, Password, Mountpoint, and SSL/HTTPS.
Custom Source Authentication: Added explicit Icecast User field (default 'source') for servers with custom administrator or DJ accounts.
Diagnostic Error Categorization: Specific feedback for HTTP 401 (Auth Failed), HTTP 404 (Mount Not Found), and browser CORS / preflight restrictions.
Dual Streaming Modes: Direct HTTP PUT and WebSocket Relay Bridge support.

changelog.title: Live Radio Broadcasting & Streaming (WebRTC WHIP, Icecast 2, Shoutcast & P2P)
changes: **Live Radio Broadcasting & Streaming Engine**
WebRTC WHIP Streaming: Ultra-low latency broadcast ingestion to Cloudflare Stream, OvenMediaEngine, Janus, LiveKit, MediaSoup, and WHIP-compatible radio distribution networks.
Icecast 2 Streaming: Direct HTTP chunked PUT & WebSocket bridge streaming in high-fidelity Ogg Opus/WebM audio (up to 320 kbps) with custom mount points and source authentication.
Shoutcast v1/v2 Streaming: Dedicated Shoutcast streaming client with SID and password authentication.
WebRTC P2P Direct Stream: Zero-server peer broadcast mode allowing direct browser-to-browser listening.
Live Master Audio Tapping: Captures the live mix from masterGain and equal-power crossfader directly into Web Audio MediaStreamDestination.
Mixer & Header ON AIR Console: Dynamic '🔴 ON AIR' flashing status indicator, uptime timer, live bitrate, MBs sent, and stream diagnostics modal.

changelog.title: Instant Track Duration Extraction & Cumulative Cued Playlist Times
changes: **Track & Playlist Duration Engine**
Instant Audio Metadata Duration: Automatically extracts and displays precise track durations for all scanned, uploaded, and dropped music files in the Track Library and Cued Playlists.
Individual Queue Total Time: Real-time duration badges on Deck A and Deck B cued playlist headers showing total runtime.
Combined Setlist Total Time: Dedicated total duration pill badge on the Cued Playlists toolbar displaying cumulative setlist time (Total = Deck A + Deck B).
Dynamic Duration Sync: Sample-accurate duration updates when tracks are decoded into Web Audio decks.

changelog.title: Cued Playlist Saving, Saved Setlists Manager & JSON Export/Import
changes: **Cued Playlist Saving & JSON Export/Import**
Local Setlist Storage: Save cued setlists to browser storage with custom names, dates, and track breakdown.
Saved Setlists Manager: Dedicated modal to view, recall (Load Both, Load Deck A only, Load Deck B only), export, or delete saved playlists.
JSON File Export: One-click export of complete cued setlists into structured, portable JSON files.
JSON File Import: Import any previously exported JSON playlist directly back into active deck queues and local storage.
Automatic Library Matcher: Attaches local audio sources to imported playlist items whenever tracks exist in the current library.

changelog.title: Duplicate Track Detection & Highlighting in Cued Playlists
changes: **Duplicate Track Highlighting**
Cross-Deck Duplicate Detection: Automatically detects and highlights if a track is cued in both Deck A and Deck B playlists with a distinct amber warning badge.
Intra-Deck Duplicate Detection: Detects if the same track is queued multiple times in the same deck with a red warning badge.
Live Tab Warning Indicator: The Cued Playlists tab badge displays a warning icon (⚠️) and count whenever duplicate tracks exist in either queue.
Status Feedback: Real-time notification when adding a song that is already queued in the opposite deck.

changelog.title: Separate Deck A & Deck B Cued Playlists and Tabbed Library
changes: **Separate Deck A & Deck B Cued Playlists**
Dedicated Deck Queues: Build, curate, and manage separate playlist queues for Deck A and Deck B independently.
Nested Tab Navigation: Seamlessly switch between the full 'Track Library' and the dual 'Cued Playlists' view with live badge counts.
Queue Control Actions: Re-order tracks (Move Up / Down), instant load (⚡ Load Now), individual item removal, playlist shuffle, and clear queue.
Quick Library Queue Buttons: Added '+Q A' and '+Q B' action buttons directly on each row in the Track Library table.
Auto-Deck Relay Integration: Continuous Auto-Deck playback now automatically draws from each deck's dedicated cued playlist first.

changelog.title: Continuous Auto-Deck Relay Play & Auto-Queue
changes: **Auto-Deck Relay Play**
Automatic Deck Handoff: When a track finishes playing on Deck A, Deck B starts playing automatically (and vice versa).
Zero Dead Air: Seamless track completion detection using sample-accurate Web Audio onended event monitoring.
Smooth Auto-Crossfade: Optional animated equal-power crossfader transition that smoothly glides to the active deck.
Continuous Auto-Queue: Automatically loads the next unplayed track from the library into the idle deck so radio playback continues indefinitely.
Mixer Relay Console: Dedicated toggle button with active neon LED indicator, Auto-XFade, and Auto-Queue controls on central mixer.
MIDI & Keyboard Shortcuts: Support for MIDI mapping (auto_relay action) and keyboard shortcut (Key P).

changelog.title: USB midi controller support and correction to visuals
changes: **Real-Time Dynamic Scrolling Waveform**
Web MIDI API : navigator.requestMIDIAccess() with hot-plug detection (devices shown live as you plug in).
Built-in presets : Pioneer DDJ-200, DDJ-400, Numark Party Mix, Behringer CMD Studio/Micro.
Auto-detect : Matches device name automatically and loads the right preset.
MIDI Learn : Select any action → click Start Learn → move a knob/button on controller → mapping saved.
Persistence : Mappings stored in localStorage and survive page reloads.
Mapped controls : Play/Pause, Cue, Sync, Loop, Hot Cues 1–4, Pitch, Volume, EQ High/Mid/Low, Jog Wheel, Crossfader, Master Volume.
Activity log :  Live monitor showing every incoming MIDI message with action name and deck.
UI sync : CC changes mirror back to on-screen sliders (volume, pitch, crossfader).
Access it via the 🎛 MIDI Controller button in the header.
**✅ Knob Rotation Fix**

The pointer indicator now pivots correctly from the centre of the knob circle using CSS transform-origin: 50% 17px on .rotary-pointer matching exactly where the knob's physical centre is relative to the line's top position.
